source.title: Set up a private limited company: Register your company

rows.measure: Companies House fee to register a private limited company online
rows.note: the page: 'It costs £100 and can be paid by debit or credit card. Your company is usually registered within 24 hours'; the private limited company is the UK's nearest form to an LLC; registering by post or through an agent or software costs differently; one register for England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland
